query: SELECT sequence.id AS "sequence_id!: i64", sequence.error AS "error!", MIN(history_entry.id) AS "trigger_id!: i64" FROM sequence JOIN message ON message.trigger_sequence_id = sequence.id JOIN history_entry ON history_entry.id = message.id JOIN world_member ON world_member.world_id = sequence.world_id JOIN player_character ON player_character.member_id = world_member.id LEFT JOIN character_group ON character_group.character_id = player_character.character_id LEFT JOIN "group" ON "group".id = character_group.group_id AND "group".retired_at IS NULL WHERE world_member.id = ? AND world_member.world_id = ? AND world_member.user_id = ? AND world_member.access = 'active' AND player_character.character_id = ? AND player_character.agent_id = ? AND sequence.error IS NOT NULL AND (? IS NULL OR sequence.id = ?) AND history_entry.id > ? AND (history_entry.branch_id = (SELECT branch_id FROM agent_history WHERE agent_id = player_character.agent_id) OR (history_entry.branch_id = "group".branch_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM message AS player_turn JOIN history_entry AS player_entry ON player_entry.id = player_turn.id JOIN agent_history ON agent_history.branch_id = player_entry.branch_id JOIN player_character AS turn_owner ON turn_owner.agent_id = agent_history.agent_id WHERE player_turn.trigger_sequence_id = sequence.id))) GROUP BY sequence.id ORDER BY MIN(history_entry.id)
